_note: Register fragment for woo-redaction-scans-and-text-layer (REQ-WRT-002). The assessment keeps the verdict OpenRegister's verifier gave the redacted file: routes and counts, never a value. DocumentRedactor sets redactionStatus verified only on a clean verdict, failed on leaking or unverifiable, and awaiting-review when OpenRegister's review gate refused the redaction. Named to sort after every other wooAssessment fragment, so its version wins the merge. Admin-only, as the rest of wooAssessment.

redactionStatus.title: Redaction status
redactionStatus.description: Whether a verified redacted version exists: verified, failed, awaiting-review (a person must check the findings first), or empty when the document is not partly public

redactionVerification.description: OpenRegister's verdict on the redacted file: the verdict (clean, leaking or unverifiable), the output mode, the routes it checked, and per finding the route and the count. Never a redacted value. Internal: never part of a public response.
redactionVerification.title: Redaction verdict

outputMode.title: Output mode
outputMode.description: How OpenRegister wrote the redacted file.

routesChecked.title: Routes checked
routesChecked.description: The routes through which a redacted value could be recovered that OpenRegister checked.

findings.title: Findings
findings.description: Per route on which a redacted value was still found, the route and how often.

route.title: Route
route.description: The route the value was found on.
